answer_html:
MyyShop is a social commerce and drop-shipping SaaS platform incubated by the major Chinese B2B cross-border e-commerce marketplace DHgate. Launched in 2020, it is designed to help social media creators, influencers, and online entrepreneurs monetize their traffic by building online stores and selling products globally.

Core Features & Offerings

  • Store Building: Provides lightweight SaaS tools to quickly set up customized e-commerce websites or social commerce stores without requiring coding knowledge.

  • Product Sourcing & Drop-Shipping: Connects sellers directly to DHgate’s extensive supplier network in China, handling product sourcing, inventory, and order fulfillment.

  • AI & Creator Marketing: Uses AI-driven tools to match social media creators (on platforms like TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube) with relevant brands and trending products to market to their followers.

  • Cross-Border Logistics: Leverages DHgate's supply chain infrastructure to manage international shipping, payment processing, and customer support.

Target Audience

  • Content creators and influencers looking to monetize their audience through affiliate links or custom stores.

  • Independent drop-shippers and micro-merchants seeking a streamlined, all-in-one supply chain solution.
